name: M'ONDUNIQ LaserIQ CALM RECOVERY Cocktail
shortDescription: Regenerating ampoule to finish carbon peeling and laser treatments. IBR-CalmDeAge, Hydrafeel-3 and D-panthenol soothe freshly treated skin. 5 × 2 ml sterile ampoules.
description:
The M'ONDUNIQ LaserIQ CALM RECOVERY Cocktail was made for the moment when the treatment is over but the skin's work is not: regeneration after carbon peeling and laser procedures. Its active concentrate combines IBR-CalmDeAge, Hydrafeel-3, D-panthenol and Ginkgo biloba, horse chestnut and witch hazel extracts, which work in harmony to support the skin's natural regeneration, reduce post-treatment redness and provide intensive hydration.

During carbon peeling the skin receives an intensive energy input that boosts cell activity and natural renewal processes. In this period the skin is particularly receptive to professional active ingredients – which is why the finishing step is one of the most important elements of the carbon peeling protocol. Controlled regeneration is just as much a goal of the treatment as renewing the skin.

The ampoule instantly soothes the skin, relieves sensitivity and the unpleasant feeling of tightness, while deeply hydrating the freshly treated surface. It supports faster skin barrier regeneration and the restoration of the skin's natural defenses, so regeneration can be faster and more pleasant.

After the treatment, clients almost immediately experience a fresher, more comfortable and more even skin feel: less red, calmer and more hydrated skin, a soft, velvety skin surface, less tightness and a healthier glow. This immediately noticeable difference is what elevates the treatment into a premium experience and allows a higher-level treatment protocol to be built.

Recommended after carbon peeling and to finish LaserIQ treatments, as well as for the intensive restoration of sensitive, couperose, rosacea-prone, redness-prone, dehydrated and reactive skin. It can be used after laser and microneedling treatments, in soothing and hydrating treatments, and as part of regenerating protocols alike.

Directions: after finishing the carbon peeling or other professional treatment, apply the entire contents of the ampoule to the cleansed skin, then gently massage it in until fully absorbed. It can be used as a standalone regenerating step or as part of a more complex treatment protocol – making it suitable for creating premium treatment packages and for selling as a standalone aftercare ampoule.
